title: Move the denial label-list quote and separator rules into the operation-message catalog
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Origin: nit 4 of the contract review on PR #32338 (card #32278).

`labelList` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` keeps the per-language quote marks and list separators for the `field_edit_denied` placeholder. Those rules live outside `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES`, so adding a fifth catalog locale means editing plugin-security too, and nothing fails when that edit is missed.

Premise re-check: `git grep -n "labelList" -- packages/plugins/plugin-security/src` lists the helper and its per-locale table.

Wanted: the catalog owns the list formatting, either as catalog entries or through `Intl.ListFormat` keyed by the resolved locale. Add a test that fails when a catalog locale has no list rule.

Clause-②: no
